name: Multiplayer
author: Sixth Front
description: Online play with friends on the game's claude.ai page. Press MULTIPLAYER on the main menu: one player hosts a game and gets a 4-letter code, friends join with the code or from the list of open games and pick a side. The host's game runs the bots, the flags and the tickets; everyone plays their own soldier, and tanks, jets and bombers are driven by whoever gets in. Gunfire, grenades, rockets, explosions, kills, revives, spotting and collapsing buildings are shared. Up to 8 players. Works with the Jets, Bombers, Armory and Vehicle Interiors mods. Your friends need access to the page on claude.ai.

One of you hosts: the host's game runs the bots, the flags and the tickets. Everyone else joins with the 4-letter code and picks a side. Tanks, jets and bombers belong to whoever gets in.

Online play works on the game's claude.ai page. Open Sixth Front from its claude.ai link and share that page with your friends from its Share menu, then host a game there. The Android app and saved copies of the page have no room to meet in.
